title: Nuclear Statecraft: The Saudi Deal and U.S.-China Competition
summary_en: The proposed U.S.-Saudi civil nuclear agreement has both risks and opportunities for U.S. national security. What would Washington gain? How might it affect global nonproliferation norms, or shape global interests in nuclear defense capacity? How might it impact U.S. competition with China?

title: The Future of the Space Data Network: How the Pentagon Can Ensure a Competitive Marketplace
summary_en: The Space Force must move quickly to build the Space Data Network, but speed should not come at the expense of competition. Matt Pearl examines how open standards, interoperability and vendor diversity can preserve strategic optionality and strengthen LEO satellite markets now.
title_cn: The Future of the Space Data Network: How the Pentagon Can Ensure a Competitive Marketplace

title: What a Driver’s License Breach Shows About Foreign Data-AI Threats
summary_en: A hacker advertised 153 million stolen driver's license images for sale. Far more than one breach, the incident exposes how foreign adversaries can amass and combine datasets and AI capabilities to build dossiers on Americans.
title_cn: What a Driver’s License Breach Shows About Foreign Data-AI Threats

title: AI Security Threats Aren’t a Hoax—But They Also Aren’t as Existential as They Might Seem
summary_en: From a national security perspective, the abuses of AI outlined in Anthropic’s report aren’t especially new or surprising—in fact, they are consistent with how threat actors already behave, using AI to enhance the speed, scale, efficacy, and reach of their operations.
title_cn: AI Security Threats Aren’t a Hoax—But They Also Aren’t as Existential as They Might Seem

title: The Long Arm of China and North Korea’s Repression
summary_en: CSIS' ongoing study found inmates in political prison camps are mobilized for manufacturing tied to Chinese orders. These abuses are not incidental; they sustain a partnership that reinforces North Korea's regime and its system of state control.
title_cn: The Long Arm of China and North Korea’s Repression
